title: Enticing Exploration
description: The sky's the limit? Nay! The sky is merely a checkpoint with this modpack of adventure and discovery!
body:
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/760c630e84fdecab8dca822af97b35d492114a83.png)

What makes this modpack great for adventurng?
- 100+ biomes!
- Hundreds of unique structures!
- Revamped Nether and End dimensions alongside the Aether!
- Tens of new bosses with Cataclysm and more!
- Iron Chests, Backpacks and AE2 for easily storing your items.
- Waystones to allow seamless transportation from area to another, keeping all your exploration progress!
- Xaero's minimap will make sure you will always know where you are!
- Custom mobs are found everywhere!

What else does this modpack offer?
- Create and several addons
- Tinker's construct for custom items
- Hundreds of cooking recipes with farmer's delight and the other dimensions.




- And a new type of fish. It isn't even too exciting.
